reason: I'd take the free listing, but I'm not putting a QR on my tables that invites every tourist to rate each dish publicly. Instagram and WhatsApp already bring my regulars back for free, and the 3 free months just delay the moment I have to decide on 59 GEL plus card fees.
objection: One bad rating on a dish from a tired tourist stays public forever and I can't answer it or take it down. In a 30-seat café that can sink a pastry I sell every day.
would_change_my_mind: If dish ratings came to me privately first and only went public if I chose to show them, and I could see real Tbilisi cafés getting more repeat guests from it.
